title: ProductPrd:ConnectNetwork

_meta.purpose: Connect Network PRD: professional networking product combining LinkedIn patterns — professional identity, career graph, job board, articles/newsletters, learning, Sales Navigator-equivalent, skills + endorsements, groups, events — with strict professional-only context, Ontology-backed relationship graph, and deep Workflow/Foundry ecosystem integration. Personal context is read-only projection only.

personal_context_projection.scope: user may expose a curated personal bio to professional network with explicit consent; no personal messages, posts, or social artifacts are ever surfaced in network context without explicit opt-in

identity.ops_surface: managed through OpenTofu-owned infrastructure and root Makefile/oya ops targets; no manual SSH troubleshooting path

crate_ref_bindings.naming_justification: BNF v4.1: oya-<product:connect>-<bounded-context:network>-<layer:kernel>; kernel is a canonical ADR-0105 layer suffix and the product/context tokens are registered by ADR-0131.
crate_ref_bindings.port_trait_ownership: owns pure domain types, port traits, and no-I/O invariants for the bounded context
crate_ref_bindings.workflow_ontology_boundary: declares Workflow/Ontology ports for cross-product integration; does not call other product crates

crate_ref_bindings.naming_justification: BNF v4.1: oya-<product:connect>-<bounded-context:network>-<layer:domain>; domain is a canonical ADR-0105 layer suffix and the product/context tokens are registered by ADR-0131.
crate_ref_bindings.port_trait_ownership: owns business rules and implements/uses kernel ports without adapter dependencies
crate_ref_bindings.workflow_ontology_boundary: uses kernel ports only; cross-product state is mediated by Workflow/Ontology contracts

crate_ref_bindings.naming_justification: BNF v4.1: oya-<product:connect>-<bounded-context:network>-<layer:app>; app is a canonical ADR-0105 layer suffix and the product/context tokens are registered by ADR-0131.
crate_ref_bindings.port_trait_ownership: owns composition/usecase orchestration and wires domain behavior to protocol adapters
crate_ref_bindings.workflow_ontology_boundary: orchestrates Workflow/Ontology adapters at the composition boundary

crate_ref_bindings.naming_justification: BNF v4.1: oya-<product:connect>-<bounded-context:network>-<layer:rest>; rest is a canonical ADR-0105 layer suffix and the product/context tokens are registered by ADR-0131.
crate_ref_bindings.port_trait_ownership: owns HTTP route/DTO mapping and calls inward; no domain rules live here
crate_ref_bindings.workflow_ontology_boundary: exposes protocol-specific handlers and delegates inward; direct cross-product calls are forbidden

identity.naming_justification: All planned connect-network crates parse as oya-connect-network-<layer>; ADR-0056 supplies the BNF discipline and ADR-0105 supplies the canonical layer enum.

acceptance_criteria.given: a user has a professional profile
acceptance_criteria.when: a colleague or recruiter searches the network
acceptance_criteria.then: only work-context profile fields are returned; personal social posts, personal contacts, and personal biography are never included unless the user has explicitly opted in with consent token

acceptance_criteria.given: a user connects with a professional contact
acceptance_criteria.when: the connection edge is created in Ontology
acceptance_criteria.then: the edge is typed context_kind=work and ownership_pillar=work; it is never accessible from personal social graph queries

acceptance_criteria.given: a recruiter runs a talent search
acceptance_criteria.then: results contain only professional-context Ontology nodes with user-consented profile visibility; open-to-work signals are only visible to recruiters when the user has set recruiter_visible=true

acceptance_criteria.given: a sales professional uses lead discovery
acceptance_criteria.when: account maps and relationship intelligence are computed
acceptance_criteria.then: lead graph is derived from Ontology professional edges and company membership only; personal social connections are never included in lead scoring

acceptance_criteria.given: an employee publishes an article or newsletter
acceptance_criteria.when: the content is indexed and distributed
acceptance_criteria.then: content is scoped to professional context; employer content policy applies for work-context articles; personal opinion articles in personal context are never visible to employer unless cross-posted with consent

acceptance_criteria.given: a user completes a learning course
acceptance_criteria.then: the certificate is added to the professional Ontology profile node; a SkilledAsserted event is emitted; the user may share to professional feed with one-click; personal learning history is separate

out_of_scope.item: personal social graph surfaced in professional network
out_of_scope.why: ADR-0208 pillar boundary; professional network is work-context only

out_of_scope.item: employer access to personal career job-search activity
out_of_scope.why: ADR-0215 personal pillar; open-to-work signals in personal context are never visible to current employer

out_of_scope.item: personal learning history visible to employer without consent

dual_context_isolation.mechanism: ConnectNetwork is a work-context-primary product; all Ontology edges, search indexes, feed content, and recruiter/sales data are ownership_pillar=work; personal context projection is opt-in with explicit consent token; Cedar policy denies personal→work reads without consent
dual_context_isolation.personal_context_projection_consent: user explicitly opts in via PersonalBioProjectionConsent token; token is revocable; projection is read-only snapshot, never live sync
dual_context_isolation.open_to_work_protection: open-to-work signal in personal context (hiding from current employer) is stored in personal pillar; never accessible to current employer even as tenant admin
